orphanChecks.name: OT status history without matching order

checks.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['AUTHORIZED'::text, 'ORDERED'::text, 'RECEIVED'::text, 'BILLED'::text])) OR ((authorized_by IS NOT NULL) AND (authorized_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((customer_id IS NOT NULL) OR ((walk_in_name IS NOT NULL) AND (TRIM(BOTH FROM walk_in_name) <> ''::text))))
CHECK ((((customer_type = 'INDIVIDUAL'::customer_type_t) AND (first_name IS NOT NULL) AND (last_name IS NOT NULL)) OR ((customer_type = 'COMPANY'::customer_type_t) AND (company_name IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((credit_note_for IS NULL) OR ((credit_note_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (TRIM(BOTH FROM credit_note_reason) <> ''::text))))
CHECK (((completed_at IS NULL) OR (started_at IS NULL) OR (completed_at >= started_at)))
CHECK (((labor_catalog_id IS NOT NULL) OR ((custom_description IS NOT NULL) AND (TRIM(BOTH FROM custom_description) <> ''::text))))
